caption: Benchmark overview. Every strategy receives the same input for an entry e = (h, R): its header and exactly the papers the curators cited, each readable as full text, abstract or title only depending on open access; the causal gene is withheld. One model writes every draft and only the generation strategy varies: three paradigms, a memory-only control with no papers, add-ons (dashed) each tested against its parent, and four ways of reading better, variants of direct reading evaluated on held-out entries with at least one paper readable in full. The same guards apply to every strategy. The audit judges each atomic claim against the papers it cites (all verdicts are model judgements); flagged claims get one repair round, except in the memory-only control and the reading-better arms (the latter audited without repair on 20 of their 41 entries). Scoring uses curator-written text about the cited papers, not whole entries: each curator paragraph is split once into a fixed fact list, and OMIM facts conveyed, the primary endpoint, is the share of those facts present in what the draft says about the paper, with partly present facts counted as half. Whether the supplied text states a fact is a stored model judgement, identical for every strategy. Main set: 100 entries; 515 cited papers (96 full text, 345 abstract only, 74 title only); 476 curator paragraphs; 6,652 fixed facts.
description: Three-column schematic plus a bottom band, 5.5 x 3.10 in (full text width; about 16:9, because the outline's 21:9 = 2.36 in cannot hold the required elements at 7 pt), body text 7 pt, headers 7.5 pt bold, Liberation Sans. Input (same for all): entry e = (h, R); header h (number, title, alternative titles); cited papers R with page icons for the access levels full text / abstract / title, 'access level a(d), set by open access'; padlock 'causal gene withheld'. Arrow into a bracket over every strategy group. Strategy (the only variable): Read and write = Direct reading (baseline) #0072B2 with dashed add-ons + Second-hand evidence and + Learned curation guide and a solid 'reading better' sub-box (checklist #8C8C8C, completeness pass #3D6F98, three-draft merge #555555, checklist + completeness pass #003A5E, the colours of fig_design_vs_reading), Agentic curator #56B4E9; Extract, then write = Evidence graph #009E73, Case table first #D55E00 with dashed + Reconciled case database; Memory first = Recall, then verify #E69F00; Control = Memory only (no papers) #000000. Bracket and arrow 'D' to One audit: paragraph -> atomic claims c, cited papers R(c) -> verdict per cited paper + verbatim quote (supported / partly / unsupported / contradicted) -> best verdict over R(c) -> one repair round for flagged claims. Arrow down to One scoring: Curator paragraph g 'curator-written per-paper text: OMIM allelic-variant descriptions in ClinVar' -> split once, without sight of any draft -> fixed fact list Phi(g) with tag 'stated / partly / not stated in the supplied text' -> each fact in the draft text citing the paper: present / partly / absent / contradicted -> OMIM facts conveyed (primary) = (present + 0.5 x partly) / facts judged; secondary: HPO disease annotations, allelic variants, causal gene, inheritance. Bottom band 'Guards for every strategy': ontology IDs only from ontology-search candidates; gene symbols normalised (HGNC); recalled cross-reference numbers removed; every paragraph cites a supplied paper. No counts, results or caption text in the image. Saved as PNG (1650 x 930 px, 300 dpi) and PDF at exactly 5.5 x 3.10 in.
